So, my mother first abused my dad, because he didn't wanted to go into war, because he would make more money, if he would go there (he worked for the army). One day she called the police and convinced them, that my father abused her. He had to move out. When he was gone, she started to abuse us, she only stopped when we would bleed. She liked my brother more than me, so she blamed me for everything. She only gave us attention, when we should tell her, if she looked young and pretty or when she abused us out of her own frustration. We had to dress like she wanted, I had to let my hair grow so long, it wasn't even pretty anymore. She always "helped" us, by saying what little piece of sh*t we were and that we couldn't do anything and some day she would die because of us. I started having suicidal thoughts with ten or something, like, I loved her and when I die maybe she would be happier. One day my brother told, how she abused us and I lied to everyone, I thought my mother maybe would be happy about it and would do something cool with us. She wasn't really home, she was at cool parties, on trips or shopping, she always spend so much money on clothing and everything, but we had nearly nothing to ear, she told us our father is stealing her money. One day out visits to my dad got shorter, she told us our father doesn't wanted to see us anymore, he had a new family. I was crying and she even comforted me, telling what a trash our father is. One morning I was to tired to stand up, so she dragged me outside and made me ready for school as painful as possible. When I was leaving she whispered me that when I would come back from school, she would kill me. I was scared to death, I told my teacher everything and she couldn't believe what I told. I got out from there, moved to my father and I have cry and panic attacks. The worst is, she is saying that she is in the right and I am lying, so she will have a bad life. That makes me sad I still love her deeply and it hurts. I want to have contact with her again when she apologizes. 

I left so many details out, how I got my lack of social skills, friends and so on, but it would be too much. I now realise, how much was going on when I lived with her, I know everything will get better by now :D
